nodes.label: Lelita's Photlibrary (App)
nodes.rationale: Romantic private web app for the couple Jeicob & Lelita built with Next.js + React + Tailwind + Framer Motion, designed to look beautiful on desktop and mobile.

nodes.label: Password Recovery Flow (SMTP/Webhook/Debug)
nodes.rationale: 6-digit code with 10-minute expiration stored in state.resetCodes. Delivery attempts in order: SMTP via Nodemailer, then RESET_EMAIL_WEBHOOK_URL webhook, then local debug mode returning the code — layered fallback so recovery works even without SMTP configured.

nodes.label: Cloudinary Local File Upload Flow
nodes.rationale: Frontend converts local file to Data URL and calls uploadFile action on /api/app; backend signs the upload with CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET and stores into CLOUDINARY_UPLOAD_FOLDER/media or /chat folders; Cloudinary's secure_url is then saved into app state.

nodes.label: MongoDB Atlas State Persistence
nodes.rationale: Backend persists users, resetCodes, phrase, theme, media, letters and chat in MongoDB Atlas via the official mongodb driver (collection app_state, document singleton) because local file writes do not work in production on Vercel; data/state.json is only an initial seed.

nodes.label: Recommended MongoDB Media Data Model
nodes.rationale: Suggested 'media' collection with owner, description, resourceType, publicId, secureUrl, dimensions and timestamps. Recommended indexes: createdAt desc for fast feed, owner+createdAt for per-user history, text index on description for search, unique publicId to avoid duplicates.

nodes.label: Media Durability Best Practices
nodes.rationale: So media never 'disappears': always use HTTPS secure_url, never delete from Cloudinary without archiving in MongoDB (and vice versa), enable Atlas backups, fixed folder scheme lelita/<year>/<month>, store public_id + resource_type to regenerate optimized URLs, visual onError fallback in UI, soft-delete via deletedAt before hard delete, periodic cron reconciliation job between MongoDB and Cloudinary.

nodes.label: Photo/Video Feed with Infinite Scroll
nodes.rationale: Collage/diary style feed with tilted cards, infinite scroll, local file upload to Cloudinary, description search, and author-only description editing.

nodes.label: Secret Letters (Jeicob / Lelita)
nodes.rationale: Separate secret letters for each partner with author-controlled editing.

nodes.label: Vercel Deployment
nodes.rationale: Connect repo to Vercel, configure env vars (MongoDB, Cloudinary, SMTP) in Project Settings, automatic deploy per branch; production persistence relies on MongoDB Atlas + Cloudinary instead of local files.

nodes.label: Design System: Archivo de amor editorial
nodes.rationale: Design system inspired by the couple's real photos (public/img/imagen1.jpeg, imagen2.jpeg): golden hill, blue sky, cream vintage-editorial clothing. The redesign was presentation-only; all existing logic (auth, reset, Cloudinary upload, edit/delete, infinite scroll, filter, QR) was preserved intact.
nodes.norm_label: design system: archivo de amor editorial

nodes.label: Color Palette (paper/ink/wine/rose/blush/gold/plum)
nodes.rationale: Defined in tailwind.config.ts: paper #FBF6EF (ivory), ink #33202E (dark plum), wine #8E2C48 (primary), rose #D96A85 (accent), blush #F6E3E6, gold #C9A253, plum #170F28 (night background). Colors derived from the couple's real photos.

nodes.label: Typography (Fraunces / Figtree / Caveat)
nodes.rationale: Loaded via next/font/google in app/layout.tsx: Fraunces (display serif, --font-display), Figtree (body, --font-sans), Caveat (handwritten, --font-hand) reserved for polaroid captions and the phrase of the day.

nodes.label: PhotoStack Component (Floating Polaroids)
nodes.rationale: Visual signature: the two real photos rendered as floating polaroids on login and hero, paired with a giant day counter in Fraunces and a beating heart ('beat' animation).

nodes.label: Night Mode (.night selector)
nodes.rationale: darkMode: ['selector', '.night'] in Tailwind — the 'night' class on <body> activates dark: variants. Deep plum background, dark glass cards, animated stars preserved. Pending idea: automatic night mode via prefers-color-scheme or local time instead of manual toggle only.

nodes.label: FloatingHearts Component
nodes.rationale: 8 rising SVG hearts with deterministic configs — never use Math.random in SSR render, to avoid hydration mismatch. Negative animation delays so the sky is already populated on load.

nodes.label: Masonry Polaroid Gallery
nodes.rationale: CSS columns (columns-1 md:columns-2) with polaroid aesthetic: adhesive tape (.tape), alternating ±1.4° rotation, hover straightens with a Framer Motion spring, whileTap for mobile.

nodes.label: Chat Redesign as Messaging Bubbles
nodes.rationale: Own messages on the right with wine-to-rose gradient; the other person's on the left in white.

nodes.label: Letters as Stationery (.stationery)
nodes.rationale: Letters styled as stationery with blush gradient and cursive signature.

nodes.label: Redesigned Lightbox (Keyboard Nav)
nodes.rationale: Keyboard navigation (Escape, arrows), position counter, backdrop blur, aria-label on controls.

nodes.label: Toasts as Floating Pills
nodes.rationale: Centered bottom floating pills animated with AnimatePresence.

nodes.label: Accessibility Measures
nodes.rationale: Global :focus-visible styles; prefers-reduced-motion disables hearts/floaty/beat/stars animations; aria-label on lightbox controls.

nodes.label: Pitfall: Overwriting Tailwind Color Scales
nodes.rationale: Defining rose: '#D96A85' in theme.extend.colors DELETES the whole rose-50…rose-900 scale and breaks existing classes like text-rose-50. Fix: rose: { ...colors.rose, DEFAULT: '#D96A85' } importing colors from tailwindcss/colors.

nodes.label: Pitfall: background-attachment fixed
nodes.rationale: background-attachment: fixed causes artifacts in full-page screenshots and has known iOS Safari bugs. Fix: move the background to body::before { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: -1 }.

nodes.label: MongoDB Atlas SRV DNS Issue in Local Dev
nodes.rationale: querySrv ECONNREFUSED _mongodb._tcp.lelita.cm7ayqf.mongodb.net — local DNS does not resolve SRV records, so GET /api/app returns 500 locally but works on Vercel. Not a code bug; use another network/DNS (8.8.8.8) or fall back to data/state.json for local dev.
nodes.norm_label: mongodb atlas srv dns issue in local dev

nodes.label: localStorage Session Trick for UI Verification
nodes.rationale: Session is stored in localStorage.lelita_session_user; setting it manually shows the logged-in UI without registering test users in the production database.
nodes.norm_label: localstorage session trick for ui verification

nodes.label: Animation Criteria (Emil Kowalski)
nodes.rationale: Only transform and opacity in infinite animations (GPU, off-main-thread via CSS); buttons use active:scale-[0.97/0.98] for instant press feedback; entrances never from scale(0) — lightbox enters from scale(0.96)+opacity; ease-out on entrances; springs (stiffness 220, damping 20) only on interruptible interactions like polaroid hover; ambient animations use negative delays so the scene is populated on load.

nodes.label: Pending Idea: Timeline 'Nuestra historia'
nodes.rationale: Chronological view of memories grouped by month using MediaItem.createdAt.

nodes.label: Pending Idea: Heart Reactions
nodes.rationale: Double tap → heart burst on photos and chat messages; requires a new action in route.ts and a new field in the types.

nodes.label: Pending Idea: Password Hashing (bcrypt)
nodes.rationale: Passwords are currently compared in plain text in the backend; migrating to bcrypt hashing would be more secure.
